name: Cloud Computing
description: Cloud fundamentals: compute, storage, networking and identity, serverless and cloud-native services, and running them well.

nodes.name: Cloud basics
nodes.desc: What the cloud is, on-demand resources, elasticity and the shared responsibility model.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain what cloud computing is, how on-demand elastic resources work and who is responsible for what.

nodes.name: IaaS, PaaS & SaaS
nodes.desc: Service and deployment models: public, private and hybrid clouds.
nodes.summary: You will be able to distinguish IaaS, PaaS and SaaS and compare public, private and hybrid cloud deployments.

nodes.name: Regions & zones
nodes.desc: Regions, availability zones, edge locations and designing for failure.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use regions, availability zones and edge locations to design systems that survive failures.

nodes.name: Virtualization
nodes.desc: Hypervisors, virtual machines and how a cloud slices physical hardware.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain how hypervisors and virtual machines let a cloud share physical hardware among many tenants.

nodes.name: Virtual machines
nodes.desc: Instance types, images, launching and sizing VMs.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose instance types, launch VMs from images and size them for a workload.

nodes.name: Object storage
nodes.desc: Buckets, objects, storage classes and durability.
nodes.summary: You will be able to store and serve data with object storage buckets and choose storage classes for cost and durability.
topics: Bucket access policies and presigned URLs

nodes.name: Block & file storage
nodes.desc: Volumes, snapshots and shared file systems.
nodes.summary: You will be able to attach block volumes, take snapshots and share data through managed network file systems.
topics: Choosing block, file or object storage

nodes.name: Managed databases
nodes.desc: Managed relational and NoSQL databases, backups and read replicas.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run relational and NoSQL databases as managed services with backups, failover and read replicas.

nodes.name: Virtual networks
nodes.desc: VPCs, subnets, route tables, gateways and security groups.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design a virtual private cloud with subnets, route tables, gateways and security groups.

nodes.name: Identity & access
nodes.desc: Users, roles, policies and least privilege.
nodes.summary: You will be able to control access to cloud resources with users, roles and policies following least privilege.

nodes.name: Load balancing & CDN
nodes.desc: Managed load balancers, DNS and content delivery networks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to distribute traffic with managed load balancers, route users with DNS and cache content with a CDN.

nodes.name: Serverless
nodes.desc: Functions as a service, event triggers and their limits.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build event-driven functions as a service and understand their cold starts, timeouts and other limits.

nodes.name: Managed containers
nodes.desc: Container services and managed Kubernetes.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run containers on managed container services and managed Kubernetes clusters.

nodes.name: Infrastructure as code
nodes.desc: Describing infrastructure in code with tools like Terraform.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe and provision cloud infrastructure in code with Terraform and manage its state.

nodes.name: Autoscaling
nodes.desc: Scaling groups, scaling policies and stateless design.
nodes.summary: You will be able to scale workloads automatically with scaling groups and policies and design services to be stateless.

nodes.name: Monitoring
nodes.desc: Metrics, logs, alarms and dashboards for cloud resources.
nodes.summary: You will be able to monitor cloud resources with metrics, logs, alarms and dashboards.

nodes.name: Cost management
nodes.desc: Pricing models, reserved and spot capacity, budgets and cost optimisation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compare cloud pricing models and keep spending under control with budgets and optimisation.

nodes.name: Cloud security
nodes.desc: Encryption, secrets, network isolation and common misconfigurations.
nodes.summary: You will be able to secure cloud workloads with encryption, secrets management, network isolation and checks for common misconfigurations.
topics: Encryption at rest and in transit
Public bucket and open port misconfigurations

nodes.name: Static site project
nodes.desc: Host a static website on object storage behind a CDN with a custom domain.
nodes.summary: You will host a static website on object storage behind a CDN with a custom domain and HTTPS.
topics: Uploading a site to a bucket

nodes.name: Three-tier app project
nodes.desc: Deploy a web app, API and database with infrastructure as code, autoscaling and alarms.
nodes.summary: You will deploy a web app, API and database using infrastructure as code, with autoscaling and monitoring alarms.
